name: Algebraic Reconstruction Technique (ART)
aliases: Reflective Tomography via Algebraic Reconstruction Technique (ART)
definition: An iterative algebraic method that minimizes the quadratic norm of the difference between acquired projections and projected reconstructed volume, avoiding explicit matrix storage.
summary: ART is an iterative tomographic reconstruction method that updates the volume estimate one angle at a time, avoiding explicit system matrix storage unlike simultaneous techniques.
